correctness.rationale: Exact positive-operator identity reconstructed from cyclic fourth-order trace words: D4=4Tr(A^3B+AB^3+A^2B^2-3ABAB). The square ||A^(1/2)(A-B)B^(1/2)||_2^2 equals Tr(A^3B+AB^3-2A^2B^2), and commutator square equals 2Tr(A^2B^2-ABAB); multiplying by 4 and 6 gives D4 exactly. Schatten Hölder puts the products in trace class for positive S4 operators; common finite-rank compressions pass the polynomial identity to arbitrary Hilbert space. Two rank-one noncommuting projections give D4=3, ||[P,Q]||_2^2=1/2 and zero first square, so 6 is sharp, also approached by PD perturbations. Unstrengthened zero requires [A,B]=0 and AB(A-B)=0; commuting compact positives admit joint eigenbasis, including possible kernel.
